It's not off the table February 17, 2026 02:53 PM Tiger Woods hasn't played on the PGA Tour since 2024. Could he return at the Masters in April. He offered a succinct answer in his Genesis Invitational press conference. The 90th Masters will take place April 9-12 at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia. Here’s a look at players who are eligible to compete, based on the tournament’s qualifying criteria.
